To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the LAT mutation that affects TCR signaling in T cells affects thymocyte selection in a TCR transgenic mouse model.
the mutation of LAT that disrupts PLC-γ1 activation causes a defect in positive and negative thycocyte selection.

the LAT Y136 F mutation leads to a defect in thymocyte positive selection in female HY TCR transgenic mice but leads to a phenotype that resembles positive selection (development of CD8+ HY TCR T cells) in male HY TCR transgenics.

the molecular mechanisms underlying T cell development and activation, and the consequences of perturbing these processes.
the role of LAT in thymocyte positive selection and the generation of autoreactive cells.
the development of T lymphocytes in the thymic cortex, which is a site of T cell maturation and selection.
